questions.a: Entry is free with a time. A tasting of three glasses is £18, paid at the bar.
Yes, if there's room. A time means you won't wait; the queue at the door shows on the home page when it's long.
About 45 minutes for the three rooms, longer if you stay at the bar.
Anyone can visit the rooms with an adult. Tastings and sales are for over-18s, and we may ask for ID.
Yes, all on one level, with seating in every room.

pages.description: Chalden, an English sparkling-wine house, and the cuvée it brought to Druid Street.
pages.intro: Chalk, three grapes, and a long wait in the bottle.

blocks.heading: Why a pop-up
blocks.body:
Cuvée No. 3 is a small release. We wanted people to taste it where it was laid down, so we built three rooms in an arch and brought the bottles with us.

When London closes, the rooms travel north.
